reuse.why: The API reuses getScheduledAmount, but approximate tolerance arithmetic duplicates the existing getApproxNumberThreshold helper.

duplication.why: The rounded 7.5% tolerance calculation is duplicated instead of shared with transaction matching.

placement.why: Expected amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts, and API serialization appropriately delegates to it.

scope.why: All edits concern schedule amount policy, its API representation, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: The ignored rounding parameter, duplicated tolerance policy, and operator argument supplied only by the API leave a misleading interface and fragmented policy integration.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts: getScheduledAmount calculates tolerance directly instead of calling shared/rules.ts:getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance expression is copied directly rather than disguised through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount adds amountOp and an isapprox branch while retaining an ignored rangeRounding parameter; its tolerance calculation bypasses getApproxNumberThreshold, and existing planning and posting callers do not supply the new operator.
